articles.headline: Kyle Walker: 'No intention' of removing Man City tattoos after radio comments
articles.description: Kyle Walker has said he has "never had any intention" of removing his Manchester City tattoos, in the wake of comments the full-back made on Wednesday.

images.name: Maresca not stressed about Man City's guilty charges
images.caption: Maresca not stressed about Man City's guilty charges

articles.headline: Wrexham boss Parkinson gets fans' backing as big win eases pressure
articles.description: Phil Parkinson was delighted with the reaction of his players as a 4-1 win over Championship strugglers Preston eased the pressure on the Wrexham boss.

images.name: Wrexham Phil Parkinson [1296x729]
images.caption: Wrexham manager Phil Parkinson acknowledges the club's fans after Saturday's win over Preston.
images.alt: Wrexham manager Phil Parkinson acknowledges fans at full time following the Sky Bet Championship match at the Racecourse Ground, Wrexham.
images.credit: Cody Froggatt/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Wrexham clinch resounding win against Preston to ease Phil Parkinson pressure
articles.description: Wrexham eased the pressure on Phil Parkinson with a 4-1 win over rock-bottom Preston in the Championship.

images.name: wrexham [594x334]
images.caption: Wrexham secured a resounding win at home against Preston.

articles.headline: Jamie Vardy scores in 20th consecutive season as Burnley beaten by Wolves
articles.description: Jamie Vardy scored in his 20th straight season on Friday when he struck for Burnley in their 2-1 Championship defeat by Wolves.

images.name:
Jamie Vardy of Burnley scores their side's first goal during the Sky Bet Championship 2026/27 match between Burnley and Wolverhampton Wanderers at Turf Moor
 [1296x729]
images.caption: Jamie Vardy signed a one-year deal at Burnley this summer.
images.alt: Jamie Vardy of Burnley scores their side's first goal during the Sky Bet Championship 2026/27 match between Burnley and Wolverhampton Wanderers at Turf Moor

articles.headline: Aaron Ramsey's Oxford briefly down to eight players, salvage a draw
articles.description: Oxford boss Aaron Ramsey was proud of his side's battling spirit as they hung on for a 1-1 draw at Mansfield with nine men after two red cards in the last 15 minutes.

articles.headline: Racism allegation mars Swansea win at Millwall
articles.description: Substitute Ronald scored a last-minute winner to keep Swansea top of the Championship after their match at Millwall was held up due to alleged racist chanting aimed at the visitors' Eom Ji-sung.
